parameters.name: RepoType
parameters.description:
仓库类型，取值：

- `PUBLIC`：公开仓库

- `PRIVATE`：私有仓库

parameters.name: TagImmutability
parameters.description:
镜像tag不可变性，取值：

- `true`：开启

- `false`：关闭

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cr update-repository --instance-id cri-kmsiwlxxdcva0000 --repo-id crr-tquyps22md8p0000 --repo-type PUBLIC --summary test_repo --detail repo-for-test --tag-immutability true --repo-namespace-name ejiayou-other --repo-name dsp/domain-microapp --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cr UpdateRepository --region cn-hangzhou --RepoNamespaceName 'ejiayou-other' --TagImmutability true --RepoType PUBLIC --InstanceId 'cri-kmsiwlxxdcva0000' --RepoName 'dsp/domain-microapp' --Summary test_repo --RepoId 'crr-tquyps22md8p0000' --Detail 'repo-for-test'
